properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SmartArtQuickStyle object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SmartArtQuickStyle object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Retrieves the unique Id of the associated SmartArtQuickStyle object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Retrieves the string name of the SmartArtQuickStyle object. Read-only.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Retrieves the description of the SmartArtQuickStyle object. Read-only.

properties.name: Category
properties.description: Retrieves the primary category name associated with the SmartArtQuickStyle object. Read-only.
